# index

The KITTYX package entry point re-exports `ThistleMachine`, `ThistleInstructionSet`, `THISTLE32`, `THISTLE64`, `THISTLE_OBJECT_MAGIC`, `THISTLE_EXECUTABLE_MAGIC`, `THISTLE_EXECUTABLE_EXTENSIONS`, `ThxEnvelope`, `DependencyRelationship` and `ProjectDependency`. Import these shared contracts to keep machine identity and dependency metadata consistent across repositories.
